        *   `x_rear`: Rear wall position (affects plenum volume/space).
        *   `z_left`/`z_right`: Plenum width (affects space for bellmouth/runner).
        *   `Lt`: Transition length (affects plenum inlet flow).
        *   `r_plan`: Rear corner rounding (affects plenum flow).
